hypothesis: Nontraditional securities-backed credit balances, utilization, concentration and channel composition add stable 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and already-tested traditional aggregate margin factors.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t TaiwanStockLoanCollateralBalance.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks present on each source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.treatment_scope: Securities-firm loans, unrestricted-purpose loans, securities-finance secured loans and settlement financing. Traditional margin balances remain in the control only.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are reduced to one immutable daily aggregate row and are not retained.

features: log nontraditional-credit balance and daily balance change
nontraditional share of total observed credit
securities-firm, unrestricted, secured-finance and settlement channel shares
20-day changes in log balance, utilization and total-credit share
feature_transform: All 14 features use only date-t and earlier observations, standardized over a causal 252-row window with at least 126 rows.
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this manifest. No result-dependent feature, threshold, date, horizon, subgroup or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: The nontraditional-credit treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise every new credit directional coefficient remains zero.
